inventory.notes: The limit written into the estimate response passes through StealthEstimateLimit (dom/quota/StealthQuotaEstimate.h): the pref in MB when > 0, Mozilla's limit otherwise. Only the reported value changes; eviction keeps Mozilla's limits. Moved here from QuotaManager::GetUsageAndLimitForEstimate in ActorsParent.cpp on 2026-10-29: Firefox 159 rewrites that function, while GetResponse is identical in 157 and 159. From 159 the group scope of the same operation (parent process only) reports the pinned quota too.

verifier.why: Written with the move; same values as the two returns it replaces.
